title: TalentBridge-API-Playground-Assessement
des: It was an Assignment Project. I was assigned to develop complex REST Endpoints. I developed several endpoints with Search and Category Endpoints, designed the MongoDB database accordingly, and developed a minimal UI in Vite for the UI interface.

keypoints.text: Developed a RESTful API with multiple endpoints for product management and search functionality. Create Product, Search, Category.
Designed and implemented a MongoDB schema for efficient data storage and retrieval.
Built a minimal UI using Vite for testing and demonstrating the API endpoints.
Implemented search and filtering capabilities for products based on category and other criteria.

title: TASK-Planet
des: It was an Assignment Project where I was assigned to implement JWT authentication login, sign-ups, and authentication validation in every request, and develop a feature where users post tasks that appear in a card showing the number of likes and comments.
tech: React, Tailwind CSS, Node, MongoDB, Express.js, JWT Authentication

keypoints.text: Implemented JWT authentication login, sign-ups, and authentication validation in every request.
Built a feature where users can post tasks that appear in a card showing the number of likes and comments.
Simple intuitive UI with Tailwind CSS.
Designed fully responsive UI with Tailwind CSS and drag-and-drop section reordering.

title: TRADE-Platform
des: It was an Assignment Project assigned to me to build a platform for listing products where clients can publish, create, delete, update, and edit products, with JWT verification for sign-in and sign-ups.

keypoints.text: Built a React frontend for the platform with a clean and intuitive user interface.
Used Node.js and Express.js to build a RESTful API for the platform. Used MongoDB database for storing the data.
Implemented JWT verification for sign-in and sign-ups, and designed the database schema.

Added features to create, delete, update, and edit products, along with a product listing page with product details, filtering, and sorting functionality. Implemented JWT only for sign-in and sign-ups.

title: RTSE-Go to WEBRTC
des: A job board aggregator that scrapes and consolidates listings from multiple platforms and uses AI to match candidates with the most relevant roles based on their resume and preferences.
tech: Next JS, Python, BeautifulSoup, OpenAI API, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS

keypoints.text: Architected an end-to-end real-time video streaming pipeline by engineering an RTSP-to-HLS conversion system in Go, applying Base64 encoding for WebRTC transport, enabling seamless live camera feed delivery to web browsers without any plugins.

Developed a high-performance Go backend service responsible for continuous RTSP stream ingestion, HLS segmentation, and real-time Base64 encoding — ensuring low-latency, stable video transmission across the WebRTC protocol at scale.

Built an interactive frontend video player using video.js to decode and render live Base64-encoded WebRTC streams in real time, backed by MongoDB storing stream metadata, frame timestamps, and coordinate data for analytics and playback reference.

title: Emotionally-AI
des: It was an Assignment Project where I integrated an OpenAI model blended with Express and MongoDB, generating insights about the emotional state of journaling and then storing that information to MongoDB via Express.js.

keypoints.text: Integrated OpenAI for the analysis of journals and generating insights about the emotional state of journaling.
Developed 5+ endpoints to store and retrieve data from the MongoDB database.
Developed an intuitive UI in Next.js with Tailwind CSS.
Developed search functionality to search insights based on the User ID.

title: Doctor_AI
des: Doctor_AI is an online blood report analysis web app that analyzes your blood report PDF and gives you brief information about your blood health.
tech: Next JS, JavaScript, CSS, TypeScript, Node

keypoints.text: Built using Next.js.
Developed 2 microservices to parse and analyze the PDF.
Used Gemini 2.0 model for the analysis of the PDF.

Currently developing the analysis dashboard and additional features like download report, WhatsApp shareable link, and a best doctor recommendation system to recommend the best doctor in your region based on your blood analysis health report.
